interface: Molex Micro-Lock Plus 2.0 wire-to-wire, single-row tin, 2 circuits

board_side.board_land: J4 legacy 2.00 mm PTH pair; NO JST header fitted
board_side.assembly: insert the factory pre-crimped female contacts into 5055700201 and retain the factory 75 mm pigtail/free-tip preparation for the first five; do NOT cut/re-strip/re-tin before the J4 fit check because that would void the drawing's free-tip diameter basis. Verify one exact factory tinned tip passes freely through an actual >=0.70 mm finished J4 barrel with no strand shaving or force, then insert the tinned conductors from the rear (B.Cu), apply solder and inspect barrel fill from the front (F.Cu), trim only as required, and keep the front-side conductive profile <=0.50 mm. If shortening is ever required, the new stripped/tinned end becomes a new workmanship qualification and must re-pass diameter/free-fit/strand inspection before use.

strain_relief.process: after solder joints pass visual/profile inspection and cleaning, form a relaxed rear-side service loop and apply a non-flowing fillet over the insulated red/black pigtails onto clean B.Cu solder mask; begin the adhesive beyond the inspected solder fillets so joints remain inspectable, bond both insulated leads to the PCB for at least 8 mm of length, and do not allow cured adhesive, wire or hard solder-wick transition to bear on the LiPo pouch or coax
strain_relief.cure: D-789 / D788-17 -- ONE CONDITION-CONTROLLED PROCESS HOLD, and the conditions are part of it.  APPLY AND CURE AT 25 +/- 5 C and 40-70 % RH, inside DOWSIL's own published 30-80 % RH cure window with margin; a moisture-cure RTV held outside that window is not on any published cure curve.  BEAD THICKNESS <= 1.0 mm: these adhesives cure from the exposed surface inward at 0.25 inch per seven days (Dow), so a 1.0 mm bead reaches its substrate in about 1.1 days and a thicker one does not.  THREE DISTINCT STATES, and they are not interchangeable: (1) TACK-FREE, published at 78 minutes at 25 C -- a TYPICAL, so the gate is a passed tack-free check and not the clock; (2) HANDLING STRENGTH, no earlier than 4 h AND after a passed tack-free check, sufficient to move the board but NOT to load the joint; (3) FULL PROCESS HOLD, >= 72 h at the stated conditions before ANY pull test, thermal test, enclosure retention test or shipment -- 72 h is the TOP of Dow's own 24-72 h window for '>90 percent of full physical properties', not the bottom.  Do not accelerate with heat while the lead is under tension.
strain_relief.disconnect_instruction: release and grip the two Micro-Lock housings; never disconnect by pulling either wire bundle
strain_relief.service_loop: preserve >=35 mm free wire from each housing before tie/bundle per Molex product specification and leave enough relaxed board-side loop that mating force is not transferred into J4 solder barrels
strain_relief.primary_source_basis: DOWSIL 3145 RTV MIL-A-46146 gray product information, ARCHIVED at hardware/demo/kicad/aqroot-demo/vendor/DOW/dowsil-3145-rtv-mil-a-46146-gray-11-1832-01-0323.pdf: one-part moisture-cure RTV, non-flow, PWB/wired-lead use, room-temperature alkoxy cure, TACK-FREE TIME AT 25 C = 78 MINUTES.  D-789 / D788-17 CORRECTED THIS LINE: it previously read 'tack-free 55 min at 50% RH' and attributed it to a Dow product page, a figure the archived datasheet does not contain.  See cure, cure_source and cure_corrects.
strain_relief.cure_source: DOWSIL 3145 RTV MIL-A-46146 gray product information, archived at hardware/demo/kicad/aqroot-demo/vendor/DOW/dowsil-3145-rtv-mil-a-46146-gray-11-1832-01-0323.pdf: 'Tack-free Time at 25 C ... minutes 78'; 'generally cured at room temperature and in an environment of 30 to 80 percent relative humidity'; 'Greater than 90 percent of full physical properties should be attained within 24 to 72 hours'; 'handled in much shorter times of about 10 to 120 minutes'; 'cure from the exposed surface inward at a rate of 0.25 inch per seven days'; 'Mild heat below 60 C may be used to increase through-put'.
strain_relief.cure_corrects: D-788 and earlier carried 'tack-free 55 min at 50% RH' attributed to a Dow product page and, in the now-retired ACC_3V3 reinforcement record, 'tack-free 30 min at 25 C / 50 % RH; handling strength 4 h'.  NEITHER MATCHES THE ARCHIVED DATASHEET, which publishes 78 minutes at 25 C and no 30-minute or 55-minute figure at all.  Round-8 (D788-17) reproduced the contradiction.  There is now ONE hold, it cites the archived document, and it separates tack-free from handling from cure.
strain_relief.adhesion_qualification: C-ADH-01, once per adhesive lot and before the first production bead: apply a representative bead to a scrap board carrying the SAME soldermask and to a scrap length of the SAME lead insulation, hold it to the full 72 h process hold at the stated conditions, then peel it and record the result.  DOWSIL publishes adhesion data for substrate families, not for this soldermask or this insulation, so the adhesion this process relies on is MEASURED rather than assumed.  NOTE: the PTFE-insulated conductor that used to need this qualification was the ACC_3V3 reinforcement lead, and D-789 retired it; the leads bonded here are the Molex 26 AWG pre-crimps, whose insulation is the one to test.

battery_side.retermination: replace factory JST-PH housing/contacts with Micro-Lock Plus plug; one conductor at a time; preserve red=BAT+ and black=GND; measure insulation OD before stripping and reject/rework the connector plan if outside the terminal/tool range

controlling_rating.basis: 5055700003-PS A6 section 4.2; both sides are 26 AWG, so the mated harness rating is 2.6 A

acceptance: board side uses exact Molex factory pre-crimped leads 2175012101 red and 2175011101 black, 75 mm, 26 AWG UL 10002; no hand-crimped board-side contact
before soldering all five boards, verify the stripped conductor of one 217501 26 AWG lead passes freely through an actual finished J4 0.75 mm PTH without strand shaving or force

measure both battery lead insulation ODs on every incoming Adafruit 328 pack before retermination; terminal specification is 0.90-1.50 mm and the 213309-5900 tool IPC-optimum range is 0.96-1.50 mm; do not crimp an out-of-range lead
battery-side 2137201000 crimps use Molex 213309-5900 or an equivalently qualified production process and are visually inspected for conductor/insulation capture
minimum battery-side crimp pull-out: AWG26 19.6 N per Molex product/application tooling specification
verify cavity polarity with DMM before first mate and after every battery retermination

strain-relieve the board pigtail exactly per the frozen DOWSIL 3145 process above; maintain >=35 mm free wire from each housing before tie/bundle; disconnect by gripping/releasing housings only, never by pulling wires
front-side J4 conductor is trimmed flush and insulated under the display per the existing display-shadow rule
first article: run published worst-case concurrent Demo load and record connector/lead temperature rise; target <30 C rise
design_intent: Restores full internal RF/NFC/IR availability with both accessory rails enabled; no protected battery copper moved. Factory pre-crimped board leads remove a first-five hand-crimp variable.
